```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


```{r}
df1 <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11bsp.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df2 <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11bbi.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

df <- df1 %>%
  select(ABSLID, ABSPID, SEX, SMKSTAT, SMOKEQ8B, SMKAGEDB, ALCSTR01, AL2K7DAY, ALCF3, AGEB) %>%
  filter(!(ABSLID == "NHS11B0009794" & ABSPID == 6)) %>%
  left_join(
    df2 %>%
    filter(!(ABSLID == "NHS11B0009794" & ABSPID == 6)) %>%
    select(ABSLID, ABSPID, EGFRKDSA, ACRNTR, ACRIPA, EGFRIMP, EGFRRESB, VDLCMRGT, FOLATREB, B12RESB, FERRCRPB),
    by = c("ABSLID", "ABSPID")
  )

```

```{r}
# Duplicate id removed
df1 %>%
  count(ABSLID, ABSPID) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}
df %>%
  count(EGFRKDSA, SEX)
```


```{r}

ckd_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    AGE = case_when(
      AGEB %in% 1:4 ~ NA_real_,
      AGEB == 5 ~ 18.5,
      AGEB == 6 ~ 22,
      AGEB == 7 ~ 27,
      AGEB == 8 ~ 32,
      AGEB == 9 ~ 37,
      AGEB == 10 ~ 42,
      AGEB == 11 ~ 47,
      AGEB == 12 ~ 52,
      AGEB == 13 ~ 57,
      AGEB == 14 ~ 62,
      AGEB == 15 ~ 67,
      AGEB == 16 ~ 72,
      AGEB == 17 ~ 77,
      AGEB == 18 ~ 82,
      AGEB == 19 ~ 85, 
    ),
    SEX = case_when(
      SEX == 1 ~ "Male",
      SEX == 2 ~ "Female",
    ),
    CKD = case_when(
      EGFRKDSA == 1 ~ "No CKD",
      EGFRKDSA %in% 2:6 ~ "CKD",
      EGFRKDSA %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ACR_status = case_when(
      ACRNTR == 1 ~ "No albuminuria",
      ACRNTR %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Albuminuria",
      ACRNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    eGFR_status = case_when(
      EGFRIMP == 1 ~ "Normal",
      EGFRIMP == 2 ~ "Impaired",
      EGFRIMP %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smoker_status = case_when(
      SMKSTAT == 5 ~ "Never smoked",
      SMKSTAT == 4 ~ "Ex-smoker",
      SMKSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Current smoker",
      SMKSTAT == 0 ~ NA_character_
    ),
    daily_smoke = case_when(
      SMKAGEDB == 1 ~ "Smoked daily for less than 10 years",
      SMKAGEDB %in% 2:3 ~ "Smoked daily for 10 - 29 years",
      SMKAGEDB %in% 4:6 ~ "Smoked daily for 30 years and over",
      SMKAGEDB == 7 ~ NA_character_,
      SMKAGEDB == 8 ~ "Never smoked daily"
    ),    
    Folate = case_when(
      FOLATREB %in% 1:3 ~ "<15 nmol/L",
      FOLATREB %in% 4:5 ~ "15–<25 nmol/L",
      FOLATREB %in% 6:7 ~ "25–<35 nmol/L",
      FOLATREB %in% 8:9 ~ "35–<45 nmol/L",
      FOLATREB == 10 ~ "≥45 nmol/L",
      FOLATREB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Vitamin_B12 = case_when(
    B12RESB %in% 1:3 ~ "<220 pmol/L",
    B12RESB == 4 ~ "220–<300 pmol/L",
    B12RESB == 5 ~ "300–<400 pmol/L",
    B12RESB %in% 6:7 ~ "400–<600 pmol/L",
    B12RESB %in% 8:9 ~ "≥600 pmol/L",
    B12RESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA_character_
  ),
    Ferritin = case_when(
    FERRCRPB %in% 1:4 ~ "<30 µg/L",
    FERRCRPB == 5 ~ "30–<50 µg/L",
    FERRCRPB == 6 ~ "50–<150 µg/L",
    FERRCRPB %in% 7:8 ~ "150–<300 µg/L",
    FERRCRPB %in% 9:11 ~ "≥300 µg/L",
    FERRCRPB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA_character_
  ),

  Vitamin_D = case_when(
  VDLCMRGT == 1 ~ "Adequate (≥50 nmol/L)",
  VDLCMRGT == 2 ~ "Mild deficiency (30–49 nmol/L)",
  VDLCMRGT == 3 ~ "Moderate/severe deficiency (<30 nmol/L)",
  VDLCMRGT %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
  ),
      
  ALC_freq_3 = case_when(
  ALCF3 == 1 ~ 7,
  ALCF3 == 2 ~ 6,
  ALCF3 == 3 ~ 5,
  ALCF3 == 4 ~ 4,
  ALCF3 == 5 ~ 3,
  ALCF3 == 6 ~ 2,
  ALCF3 == 7 ~ 1,
  ALCF3 == 98 ~ NA_real_,
  ALCF3 == 97 ~ NA_real_,
  ALCF3 == 99 ~ NA_real_,
  ALCF3 %in% c(0, 8, 9, 10) ~ 0
  ), #How many days a week, that they drink three or more standards, over the last year

    Vitamin_D = case_when(
    VDLCMRGT == 1 ~ "Adequate (≥50 nmol/L)",
    VDLCMRGT == 2 ~ "Mild deficiency (30–49 nmol/L)",
    VDLCMRGT == 3 ~ "Moderate/severe deficiency (<30 nmol/L)",
    VDLCMRGT %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
  ),
  
    Alcohol_risk = case_when(
    ALCSTR01 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "High risk",
    ALCSTR01 %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Risky",
    ALCSTR01 %in% c(5, 6) ~ "Low risk",
    ALCSTR01 == 8 ~ "No alcohol (past year)",
    ALCSTR01 == 9 ~ "Never has alcohol",
    ALCSTR01 %in% c(0, 7) ~ NA_character_
  ),
    Alcohol_risk_7day = case_when(
    AL2K7DAY == 1 ~ "Low risk",
    AL2K7DAY == 2 ~ "Medium risk",
    AL2K7DAY == 3 ~ "High risk",
    AL2K7DAY == 4 ~ "No alcohol (1 week–<12 months)",
    AL2K7DAY == 5 ~ "No alcohol (≥12 months)",
    AL2K7DAY == 6 ~ "Never has alcohol",
    AL2K7DAY %in% c(0, 8, 9) ~ NA_character_
  ),
  
  eGFR_range = case_when(
    EGFRRESB == 1 ~ "90+",
    EGFRRESB == 2 ~ "75-89",
    EGFRRESB == 3 ~ "60-74",
    EGFRRESB == 4 ~ "45-59",
    EGFRRESB == 5 ~ "30-44",
    EGFRRESB == 6 ~ "<30",
    EGFRRESB %in% c(7,8) ~ NA_character_,
  )
  )
```


```{r}
# Calculate the proportion within each sex
ckd_prop <- ckd_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SEX), !is.na(CKD)) %>%
  group_by(SEX, CKD) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SEX) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))
```


Alcohol Section of Dataset.

```{r}
alcohol_type <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11b14.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE) %>%
  select(
    ABSLID,
    ABSPID,
    ABSBID,
    ABSTID,
    ALCTYPT,
    TOTPALCR,
    ALCSDCDT,
  )
```

```{r}
alcohol_quantity <- df1 %>%
  select(
    ABSLID,
    ABSPID,
    ALINWKSD
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    alcohol_quantity = case_when(
      ALINWKSD == 97 ~ 0,          # Did not drink last week
      ALINWKSD >= 0 & ALINWKSD <= 96 ~ ALINWKSD,  # Actual alcohol intake in last week 
      ALINWKSD %in% c(98, 99) ~ NA_real_  # Not stated/unknown or not applicable,
    )
  )
```

```{r}
alcohol_type %>%
  count(ALCTYPT)
```

```{r}
alcohol_type <- alcohol_type %>%
  mutate(
    alcohol_type = case_when(
      ALCTYPT == 1 ~ "Low_alcohol_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 2 ~ "Mid_strength_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 3 ~ "Full_strength_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 4 ~ "White_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 5 ~ "Red_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 6 ~ "Low_alcohol_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 7 ~ "Champagne_sparkling_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 8 ~ "Spirits_RTD",
      ALCTYPT == 9 ~ "Liqueurs",
      ALCTYPT == 10 ~ "Spirits",
      ALCTYPT == 11 ~ "Fortified_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 12 ~ "Cider",
      ALCTYPT == 13 ~ "Cocktails",
      ALCTYPT == 14 ~ "Other",
      ALCTYPT == 0 ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Keep one record for each participant and alcohol type
alcohol_type_person <- alcohol_type %>%
  filter(!is.na(alcohol_type)) %>%
  distinct(ABSLID, ABSPID, alcohol_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = alcohol_type,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
# Combine alcohol type and alcohol quantity at the participant level
alcohol_person <- alcohol_quantity %>%
  left_join(
    alcohol_type_person,
    by = c("ABSLID", "ABSPID")
  )
```

```{r}
# Add alcohol information to the main participant-level dataset
df_final <- ckd_data %>%
  left_join(
    alcohol_person,
    by = c("ABSLID", "ABSPID")
  )
```

```{r}
alcohol_type %>%
  count(alcohol_type)
```



```{r}
alcohol_type_prop <- df_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(SEX), !is.na(CKD)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Low_alcohol_beer,
      Mid_strength_beer,
      Full_strength_beer,
      White_wine,
      Red_wine,
      Low_alcohol_wine,
      Champagne_sparkling_wine,
      Spirits_RTD,
      Liqueurs,
      Spirits,
      Fortified_wine,
      Cider,
      Cocktails,
      Other,
    ),
    names_to = "alcohol_type",
    values_to = "consumed"
  ) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(consumed), consumed == 1) %>%
  group_by(SEX, alcohol_type, CKD) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SEX, alcohol_type) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))

alcohol <- c("Low_alcohol_beer", "Mid_strength_beer", "Full_strength_beer", "Low_alcohol_wine", "White_wine", "Red_wine", "Fortified_wine",  "Champagne_sparkling_wine", "Spirits_RTD", "Liqueurs","Spirits",  "Cider", "Cocktails")
```


```{r}
alc_quantity_prop <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SEX),
    !is.na(CKD),
    !is.na(alcohol_quantity)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    alcohol_group = cut(
      alcohol_quantity,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 4, Inf),
      labels = c("0", "0–1", "1–2", "2–4", ">4")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SEX, alcohol_group) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_CKD = mean(CKD == "CKD"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
alc_quantity_prop
```

The smoking and micronutrient data. To avoid information loss, we did not shrink data for alcohol and CKD if smoking and micronutrients was missing. 

```{r}
smoker_status_prop <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SEX),
    !is.na(CKD),
    !is.na(smoker_status),
    !is.na(daily_smoke),
  ) %>%
  group_by(SEX, daily_smoke) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_CKD = mean(CKD == "CKD"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
smoker_prop <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SEX),
    !is.na(CKD),
    !is.na(smoker_status),
  ) %>%
  group_by(SEX, smoker_status) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_CKD = mean(CKD == "CKD"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```



```{r}

micro_prop <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SEX),
    !is.na(CKD)
  ) %>%
  select(SEX, CKD, Folate, Vitamin_B12, Ferritin, Vitamin_D) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Folate, Vitamin_B12, Ferritin, Vitamin_D),
    names_to = "micronutrient",
    values_to = "category"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  group_by(micronutrient, SEX, category) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_CKD = mean(CKD == "CKD"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
#Not including Micronutrient Data

df_filter <- df_final %>%
  select(
    SEX,
    CKD,
    alcohol_quantity,
    Low_alcohol_beer,
    Mid_strength_beer,
    Full_strength_beer,
    White_wine,
    Red_wine,
    Low_alcohol_wine,
    Champagne_sparkling_wine,
    Spirits_RTD,
    Liqueurs,
    Spirits,
    Fortified_wine,
    Cider,
    Cocktails,
    ALC_freq_3,
    Alcohol_risk,
    Alcohol_risk_7day,
    AGE,
    smoker_status,
    daily_smoke,
    eGFR_range,
    
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SEX),
    !is.na(CKD),
    !is.na(alcohol_quantity),
    !is.na(Red_wine),
    !is.na(ALC_freq_3),
    !is.na(Alcohol_risk),
    !is.na(Alcohol_risk_7day),
    !is.na(AGE),
    !is.na(smoker_status),
    !is.na(daily_smoke),
    !is.na(eGFR_range),
    AGE >= 35
  )
```

```{r}
table(df_filter$eGFR_range)
```


```{r}
# Convert variables to factors
df_filter <- df_filter %>% 
  filter(AGE != "< 18 years") %>%
  mutate(
    CKD = factor(
      ifelse(CKD == "CKD", 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1)
    ),
    SEX_factor = factor(
      SEX,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
          
     Alcohol_risk = factor(
      Alcohol_risk,
      levels = c(
        "Low risk",
        "Risky",
        "High risk"
      )
    ),
    Alcohol_risk_7day = factor(
      Alcohol_risk_7day,
      levels = c(
        "Low risk",
        "Medium risk",
        "High risk"
      )
    ),
    smoker_status = factor(
      smoker_status,
      levels = c(
        "Current smoker",
        "Ex-smoker",
        "Never smoked"
      )
    ),
    daily_smoke = factor(
      daily_smoke,
      levels = c(
      "Never smoked daily",
      "Smoked daily for less than 10 years",
      "Smoked daily for 10 - 29 years",
      "Smoked daily for 30 years and over"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Never",
      "<10 years",
      "10-29 years",
      "30+ years"
    )
    ),
    eGFR_range = factor(
      eGFR_range,
      levels = c(
        "<30",
        "30-44",
        "45-59",
        "60-74",
        "75-89",
        "90+"
      )
    ),
    
    across(
      c(
        Low_alcohol_beer,
        Mid_strength_beer,
        Full_strength_beer,
        White_wine,
        Red_wine,
        Low_alcohol_wine,
        Champagne_sparkling_wine,
        Spirits_RTD,
        Liqueurs,
        Spirits,
        Fortified_wine,
        Cider,
        Cocktails
      ),
      ~ factor(
          .x,
          levels = c(0, 1),
          labels = c(0, 1)
        )
    )
  )

saveRDS(df_filter, "shared_df_filter.rds")

#We need to do the smoking / micronutrient secondary study in a separate data frame (It removes more people)
```
